name: Shokanbetsu-Teuri-Yagishiri Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 暑寒別天売焼尻国定公園
aliases: 暑寒別天売焼尻国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of Hokkaido's western coast: the Shokanbetsu volcanic peaks, and the Teuri and Yagishiri sea-cliff islands in the Sea of Japan.
notes: Designated by MOE; managed by Hokkaido. Ferry from Haboro reaches the islands.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.description: 北海道西海岸の国定公園。暑寒別火山群と、日本海に浮かぶ天売島・焼尻島の海食崖の島々が広がる。
ja.notes: 環境省指定・北海道管理。羽幌からフェリーで島へアクセス。
